ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (creamy-white/tan) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) distribution across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous region covering the central lobes; low-intensity (black) pixel regions localized at the leading edges, fluke tips, and a distinct vertical bisection at the median notch. Small circular low-intensity clusters (mottling) are present in the interior sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio of 1:5 relative to the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by pixel-amplitude variations of 3-8 pixels along the entire trailing boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following a parabolic path on the trailing edges, terminating in sharp, slightly upturned terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of discrete dark circular pixel clusters on the high-intensity background; specifically, two clusters on the left lobe mid-section and one prominent spot on the right lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark focal pigment spot located approximately 100 pixels to the right of the median notch; irregular low-intensity terminal tip on the left lobe showing potential minor tissue loss or unique pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronest yellowish-tan chromatic shift across the high-intensity pixels, likely representing diatom colonization, contrasting with pure white pixels near the peduncle junction.
